claim: executable missing-premise diagnosis; no atomic physical prediction

controls.feedback_intervention: feedback off after common first round, with the same forced admissible orientation path
controls.passive_observation: observer=False must preserve complete trajectory and RNG state
controls.state_label_control: two declared spectroscopy-state requests share one generic config because the state-to-native map is absent

evaluation.countermodel_residual_role: descriptive diagnostic only; no selected law or empirical AOD score
evaluation.criterion_origin: retrospective; targets already exposed, not a preregistered or independent test
evaluation.envelope_semantics: descriptive rectangular source envelopes; not joint confidence intervals; no Gaussian law, independence or coverage probability assumed
evaluation.exposure: retrospective; known targets predate this protocol
evaluation.failure_policy: A valid out-of-domain witness or violated claimed invariant rejects the declared candidate; a future calibrated empirical rejection applies to the frozen model-and-observation conjunction, not all AOD.
evaluation.family_ratio_criterion: Under identification of the stipulated bridge with the selected H/D/T targets, every common-gain isotope ratio must lie in the ratio envelope formed from reported values plus/minus their quoted uncertainty magnitudes. One failed ratio excludes the whole common-Z gain family from that diagnostic criterion.
evaluation.revision_policy: Record a new protocol and preserve the failed version before changing laws, targets, exclusions or criteria.
evaluation.whole_law_gate: incomplete if any requested physical observable lacks its state/observation law; never substitute a derived duplicate for an independent observable

global_map_family.dimensional_status: typed positive maps only; no energy operator, rest-mass law or physical identification is established
global_map_family.domain: pilot Z in {1,2,55}; lambda >= 0; q_i and q_Cs positive bounded cadences
global_map_family.selection: none; all witnesses are unselected countermodels

reference.role: retained exact Cs SI definition only; not a realized clock

reference_policy: configuration-specific generic reference; comparison to Cs below is a stipulated diagnostic bridge, not an identified atomic frequency ratio

source_bindings.role: Main definitions consumed by a downstream application; no Main change

stopping_rule: three inner rounds and one new outer reclosure for every pilot
